messages.author: Baker, Joseph
messages.body:
Hi all,
I am working with a PDB structure that has lipids embedded into it along
with protein subunits. They are PG lipids. I've been looking at the manual
and papers referenced therein and I saw that Lipid11 had both a PGR and PGS
lipid type, but that the Lipid17 force field introduces only the PGR type.
Are there also Lipid17 PGS parameters available somewhere?
Thanks,
Joe
